sec.title: September 2 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 593)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 2** across classic superhero serialized story arcs, grim Scotland Yard true-crime artifacts, and chart-topping big band vocal variety, Bud Collyer as *Superman* for Kellogg's Pep across four different storylines (1942, 1943, 1946, 1948), Orson Welles hosting *The Black Museum* (1952), and Vaughn Monroe performing *Mona Lisa* on *The Camel Caravan* (1942–1952):
